method: Read-only code/diff/raw inspection plus offline hash and in-memory reverse-delta validation. Reviewer did not run Linux probes, guards, services or builds, change source, or repeat admission.

delta.scope: One lawful command adds container-side cat/readback test; no oracle/default/cleanup change.

observed_guards.r3_real_pinned_busybox_shell_guard: positive rc0 and exact 20B SHA ea4d5008b6db38998d7e16650080b3cf75bcebaeb494ae9238568bf08b2a2170; wrong-content readback rc1

findings.conclusion: Oracle requires ERROR, production_ready false and anchored unknown field source. Generic busy, wrong field, accepted request, unrelated denial or missing error cannot pass.

Snapshots read actual runc state, /proc PID starttick and boot ID, namespace dev/inode, actual /proc/<pid>/root/workspace dev/inode and exactly one workspace mountinfo row. Verified grant/runtime structure is checked, and full before/after dictionaries must be identical.

Controller command-* files are inventoried by name and full-byte SHA, including command metadata, stdout, stderr and exit records. Added, removed and changed artifacts cannot pass; the observer runc state calls are outside that controller artifact directory.

Lawful command uses noclobber, writes and syncs the sentinel, reads it inside the container and tests the text. The FUSE view separately requires all exact 20 bytes including newline. Fixed Rust returns Executed only after run_recorded actual successful exit without timeout/cancel reason; raw command/exit artifacts remain required at runtime.

Source selector is opt-in and mutually exclusive with semantics-only/probe. It omits the unchanged 64MiB and mixed groups; new probe is imported only in the new branch. Existing basic/semantic command branches and prior cleanup are otherwise unchanged; no new dependency for those cases.

Output directory is exclusive/fresh. Request, response and before/after evidence are saved before oracle evaluation; parent catches failure and retains error while attempting existing owned cleanup. R1/R2 evidence and original preflight were not rewritten.

Existing controller KILL for its owned container is recorded cleanup, not graceful application drain. Contract stop clarification remains applicable. PID absence alone is insufficient: runtime-empty, exact normal detach and actual Node/Meta processctl closure must be checked in final runtime review.

admission.runtime: official runc1.5.2 fixed d10e SHA; static ldd; package/Meta/Node fixed6d identity and libraries checked
admission.rootfs: six pinned regular template files; no live-container-root snapshot
admission.budget_and_protected_final_status: PENDING_RUNTIME_POSTCHECK; preflight free/RAM and protected inventory do not prove final allocation or closure.
